text:
1. 17. 57

Ajjhattāyatana anattasuttaṃ

224. cakkhuṃ bhikkhave anattā, sotaṃ anattā, ghānaṃ anattā, jivhā anattā, kāyo anattā, mano anattā. Evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati. Sotasmimpi nibbindati, ghānasmimpi nibbindati, jivhāyapi nibbindati, kāyasmimpi nibbindati, manasmimpi nibbindati. Nibbindaṃ virajjati, virāgā vimuccati vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti. Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti.
